rationale.collectionCheck: shoumenchougou author listing (https://huggingface.co/api/models?author=shoumenchougou&search=rwkv7) contains only G1/G0 reasoning-variant GGUFs (RWKV7-G1a..G1g etc.), no plain World 2.9B; DoD prefers World over G1-reasoning, so Mungert/rwkv7-2.9B-world-GGUF is the primary pin.
